thread:
Nina (CSM): quick preflight from VelvetHarbor week0 dry-run. two low/medium blockers: outbound CIDR narrower than our spec, KMS key policy missing infra principal, and audit log prefixes inconsistent with their SIEM. performance otherwise fine.

Hector (VelvetHarbor): thanks. infra mistakenly used 198.51.100.0/26 instead of the /24 we gave them; they only had that allocation available.

Gabe (Solutions): we can accept an additional /26 to cover the remainder, but prefer the /24. ask them to add 198.51.100.64/26 to match docs.

Omar (Eng-Infra): recommended SG egress (AWS):
```
Type: All TCP
Protocol: TCP
Port range: 0-65535
Destination: 198.51.100.0/24
Description: Redwood egress (api.redwood.internal)
```
If they leave only /26 some requests will drop under load.

Hector (VelvetHarbor): i'll get the second /26 requested now.

Leah (SRE): audit logs: our forwarder prefixes streams as `velvet-prod` and `vh-internal`. Their SIEM filter only picks `velvet-prod`. we should normalize during ingest to `velvet-prod` for all streams to avoid missed events.

Nina (CSM): KMS rotation note: client policy schedules key rotation Friday 03:00 local. our standard MR is Saturday 02:00 — compat question. can infra have a minimal policy snippet?

Omar (Eng-Infra): minimal KMS policy to add to key policy (paste into their key policy editor):
```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-infra"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
That should allow our infra role to rotate and not break their rotation schedule.

Hector (VelvetHarbor): pasted and saved. rotation remains Friday 03:00.

Gabe (Solutions): retention: their compliance requires 180d. pipeline default was 30d. storage can do 180d but needs an env change. I'll coordinate.

Leah (SRE): opened ticket CI-7421 to extend retention to 180d and added a 7-day rollover snapshot to cover the transition.

notify-bot: Dry-run artifacts: https://deploys.redwood.internal/reports/6299999999  artifacts: nettrace.tgz, kms-snippet.json, audit-sample.log

Nina (CSM): action summary: Omar - confirm SG change and run smoke; Gabe - lead retention change and timeline; Leah - normalise audit prefixes and validate SIEM; Hector - confirm second /26 and finance watch. Renewal risk: finance flagged potential review if cutover slips past two weeks (end of month). marking as medium risk in account tracker.

Hector (VelvetHarbor): second /26 requested, infra ETA 2h. finance will wait a week post-cutover before escalating.

Omar (Eng-Infra): will run smoke after their push, ETA ~90m.

Gabe (Solutions): i'll share retention schedule by EOD.

Leah (SRE): will update CI-7421 when SIEM picks up normalized prefix.

Nina (CSM): great, update the thread when done and i'll reconcile renewal radar. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
